purpose: Explicit context envelope for AI-generated Segment 101 artifacts. Fleet Data is a companion segment that only appears when the transaction is on a fleet-eligible card/program.

transactionType.notes: 0 authorization request, 5 refund, 6 pre-authorization, 7 balance inquiry, S completion, C cancellation, U timeout reversal are the fleet-relevant financial transaction types. Confirm final subset against Petroleum Industry Processing Specifications.

cardType.values: REVIEW_REQUIRED subset (fleet-eligible card types only; not the full 36 financial card types)
cardType.notes: Segment 101 must not be certified for non-fleet card types. Enumerate the exact fleet card codes during Wave 2 from Appendix E.

paymentNetworkType.notes: PETROLEUM_PROPRIETARY is separate-domain and must declare its specialized-domain metadata.

lifecycleRole.notes: Fleet Tags 1-5 are exclusive to AUTH_COMPLETION.

messageFamily.notes: FINANCIAL_RESPONSE presence is REVIEW_REQUIRED until an authoritative response-side reference is located.

companionParentSegment.notes: Segment 101 is a Data Section 3 companion; Segment 100 must be present in the same message.

conditionalContext.posEntryMode: Appendix J Table 005 — fleet entry modes; enumerate during Wave 2
conditionalContext.productCodePresence: Segment 102 may accompany Segment 101 when fuel/product data is captured
conditionalContext.hostPromptsSupported: Required for Fleet Tags 1-5 in Auth Completion messages
conditionalContext.responseCode: Element 83 for the outer financial response
conditionalContext.declineCode: Element 26 for the outer financial response
conditionalContext.authorizerCode: Element 7 for the outer financial response

lifecycleContext.originalSequenceNumber: required for follow-up and retry artifacts (persisted from Segment 100)
lifecycleContext.currentSequenceNumber: required for every transaction artifact (from Segment 100)
lifecycleContext.terminalId: required for device-bound lifecycle comparison (from Segment 100)
lifecycleContext.accountIdentity: required when the fleet program mandates identity correlation
lifecycleContext.amountContext: requested or approved amount from Segment 100 fuel/nonfuel/tax fields
lifecycleContext.approvalReference: required when the completion carries approval linkage
lifecycleContext.fleetTagsPersistence: Fleet Tags 1-5 present only in Auth Completion (0220) and are NOT expected to persist across cancellations or reversals

validationRules: Do not certify Segment 101 for non-fleet card types.
Do not certify Fleet Tags 1-5 in messages other than Auth Completion (0220).
Do not certify Segment 101 in messages that also carry Segment 145 (Enhanced Fleet); this combination must be rejected.
Do not infer companion Segment 102 presence from Segment 101 alone; check Segment 100 fuel/product amounts.
Do not certify PETROLEUM_PROPRIETARY payment network behavior without specializedDomain metadata plus Petroleum Industry Processing Specifications evidence.
Do not treat generic Segment 100 fixtures as evidence of Segment 101 coverage.
Do not treat generic Fleet card fixtures as evidence of Petroleum Industry Processing Specifications coverage.
Missing fleet-program context is REVIEW_REQUIRED unless the ATL105 spec explicitly proves it is unnecessary.
